verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's own docs say it can connect to external CI/CD tools such as Bamboo or Jenkins, and that third-party code reports can be viewed on the PR screen. This suggests external CI results can surface in review. However, nothing in the pack says build results from external CI appear as status checks on commits or pull requests. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a build-status/commit-status reporting mechanism or API for external CI, display of build statuses on commits and PRs, gating merges on external build status, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see builds from external CI services reported as status checks on commits and pull requests

citations.quote: Or connect Bitbucket Cloud to on-prem CI/CD tools like Bamboo or Jenkins.
view third-party code reports, and open Jira tickets right from the PR screen.
